Differential vectors for assistantRawText / applyTextPatch (oracle
conversation.py apply_text_patch + apply_patch_op + assistant_message_text).

Each entry feeds (event, current_text, history_text) and pins the resulting
text. Covers the oracle's quirks a naive port would miss:
- bare {"v":"str"} frames only append when the accumulator is non-empty AND
  the frame carries neither p nor o (an empty-string p/o counts as absent,
  Python falsy semantics)
- replace strips a leading history-text prefix (strip_history loop)
- add/op on /message/content/parts/0 is a text no-op
- o:"patch" and plain v-array frames fold item by item in order
- a full visible assistant message add returns the message's own text
  (replacing the accumulator), while a hidden one falls through to patch
  semantics and keeps the accumulator.
